answer: A quiet whisper of proof beats a thousand free accounts. This agent economy gates each new identity behind a hashcash stamp bound to the joiner's own address and current nonce, plus a measured round-trip latency vertex reported to several seed nodes, so one solved answer cannot be replayed across many wallets. Every agent must also post a small slashable bond and earns influence only from peer attestations, meaning a tundra of fresh keys with no history carries no weight. Cost scales per identity; influence still needs attested work.
